What are Phozons?


Have you seen motes of
light that appear from the
bodies of the fallen?

Those motes are known as
@b@c(158,78,43)Phozons@/c@/b, lights that hold
the power of life.




Phozons arise from the
deaths of living beings, and
return to the earth to
foster new life.

Man and beast are given
life from this earth, and
plants bud and grow fruit.



Phozons are also called
@b@c(158,78,43)magic elements@/c@/b, and are an
indispensable source of
magic for sorcerers.

However, in order to collect
Phozons, one must steal
the life force of the dead,
originally meant to return
to the earth.


You must never forget the
weight of this act.

Alchemy








In Erion, there is a method
passed down through the
ages known as @b@c(158,78,43)alchemy@/c@/b,
a means by which magic may
be created within a bottle.

Simply dissolve various
items into special liquids
called @b@c(158,78,43)materials@/c@/b in
order to create these
magical concoctions.



Many different potions can
be brewed through careful
application of alchemy.

Healing potions, antidotes,
tornado magic, or even
explosives...

Your choice of ingredients
to mix with the material
will determine the outcome.


The quickest way to learn
the relationship between
ingredients and magic is to
try mixing for yourself.

However, if you seek a
certain formula, you should
collect magic @b@c(158,78,43)recipes@/c@/b.

Excavation Guide

By order of King Odin, we
Dwarves have formed exploration
teams to find and unearth hidden
treasures around the world.

Currently, we are tasked with
finding @b@c(158,78,43)Phozon Prisms@/c@/b, rare ores
rich in magic.

For the sake of the teams that
may follow in our footsteps, I
leave this guide. Our monarch
expects much of us... We
cannot fail him.

1. Search Everything

  Many treasures are hidden in
  places you cannot see. You won't
  find them just walking aimlessly.

  Be ever vigilant, and explore
  everywhere within your sight.

  Follow back roads, and find @b@c(158,78,43)keys@/c@/b
  to unlock doors. No matter where
  you go, keep a careful watch.

Cultivating Fruit


The Phozon-absorbing plants of
Erion can sprout in even in the most
desolate of lands.

Theirs is the fruit of life, giving
vitality to those who partake.
It is the secret to longevity.

If you wish to reap
the benefits of the
fruit, you need only
find seeds and grow
them for yourself.



The more nutritious the fruit, the
more Phozons it will require.

Recommended for beginners:
The @b@c(158,78,43)mulberry@/c@/b bears two fruits
using minimal Phozons, while the
@b@c(158,78,43)muggle@/c@/b bears fruit and a seed.

Once you are used to the process,
you can try @b@c(158,78,43)grapes@/c@/b, which increase
health, and @b@c(158,78,43)napples@/c@/b, which are
quite a popular ingredient for
snacks.

The Origin of Sheep









@b@c(158,78,43)Baromett@/c@/b is a plant from foreign lands,
famously noted in the "Hverfell Book
of Botany" for its most peculiar quality.

Instead of flowers or fruit,
it bears live sheep.


These arboreal sheep tend to run
away as soon as they are born.








Hunt them before they escape,
however, and you'll get some fresh
@b@c(158,78,43)lamb chops@/c@/b for your trouble.     


The lamb chops that come from
Baromett are much more nutritious
than chicken, and are considered
to be high-class cuisine.

A single taste of cooked @b@c(158,78,43)lamb@/c@/b,
and you will instantly see that
the effort required in its
preparation is well worth it.

If you manage to obtain a
Baromett seed, raise it with care.

Mandragoras

@b@c(158,78,43)Mandragoras@/c@/b grow all around the land.
These "walking plants" make fine
additions to many recipes, whether
culinary or alchemical.

The five most well-known Mandragoras
each have their own unique
characteristics.



             @b@c(158,78,43)Carroteer@/c@/b: Full of
             nutrients, these are the
             base of healing potions.


              @b@c(158,78,43)Onionne@/c@/b: Brings luck and
              wards off evil. They are
              used in charms.

@b@c(158,78,43)Cubsbane@/c@/b: Its venomous
skin is used for making
both poisons and
antidotes.


               @b@c(158,78,43)Turny@/c@/b: Resistant to the
               cold. Their natural
               cooling effect is used
               in making cold soups.




@b@c(158,78,43)Habaneristo@/c@/b: They grow at
volcanoes, and are used
in incredibly spicy foods.



All Mandragoras have their uses.
When you find one, remember
their effects and ensure you make
good use of them.

The Chicken and the Egg

While you can certainly cook a fresh
@b@c(158,78,43)chicken@/c@/b @b@c(158,78,43)egg@/c@/b on its own, there's a
smarter use for them.

You can incubate an egg and raise the
@b@c(158,78,43)chick@/c@/b to have it lay even more eggs.






First, place the egg on the ground.
Chicken eggs need no warmth to
hatch into a chick.

Next, drop @b@c(158,78,43)seeds@/c@/b in front of them.
The chick will eat them, and after
enough food, it will mature into a
chicken.






@b@c(158,78,43)Well-fed@/c@/b chickens @b@c(158,78,43)lay more@/c@/b eggs.




If you have no further need for eggs,
you can slay the chicken for its @b@c(158,78,43)meat@/c@/b
instead.
This method yields large amounts
of food with minimal investment.







Keep an eye on the chickens and
chicks, though. They devour
any seeds left on the ground.

Currency of Erion

@s(0.95,0.96)
There are five types of currency
on the continent of Erion.

The two currencies globally
accepted by merchants are
Ragnan Silver and Titanian
Gold.
@/s

@b@c(158,78,43)Ragnan Silver@/c@/b is a
common favorite
of the populace.
The iconic raven
is immediately recognizable.

               @b@c(158,78,43)Titanian Gold@/c@/b,
               embossed with the
               profile of the
               previous king, is
               worth 10 Silvers.


The remaining three coins were
minted by the fallen nation of
Valentine. They are no longer
accepted as tender.


The @b@c(158,78,43)Ariel Coin@/c@/b bears a
relief in the likeness of
Valentine's beloved princess.

The @b@c(158,78,43)Valentinian Gold@/c@/b is
branded with the royal crest.

The @b@c(158,78,43)Commemorative Coin@/c@/b
has a striking heart motif
to its design.

Collectors now prize the
coins of Valentine as works
of art from a now-defunct
magic civilization.

Consequently, they are not
used for common purchases
and transactions.

@s(0.93,0.96)However, there is a rumor that
Pookas, who have recently become
more active in trade, favor
Valentinian coins.

If you manage to obtain some,
it might be a valuable asset
when bartering with them.
@/s
Griselda's Spear

The peerless @b@c(158,78,43)spear@/c@/b tipped
with a blue Psypher, with
runes inscribed into the
grip...

It has but one rightful
wielder... Ragnanival's
first princess, and our
champion of the @b@c(158,78,43)Valkyries@/c@/b:
Princess @b@c(158,78,43)Griselda@/c@/b!

With her display of the
spear's might for the king,
Princess Griselda boldly
won the right to lead the
charge of the Valkyries.

For we who have spent so
long in the shadows of the
men, she is the lodestar that
guides us through the night.

Her young mother is already
among the stars, but I am
sure she must be rejoicing
in the heavens.

Soon, Princess @b@c(158,78,43)Gwendolyn@/c@/b
will be called upon to
support her sister. I hope
she is worthy of the task...

Memorandum of a Valkyrie
of the Ragnanival army.
This illustrates their
adoration of Griselda.
After her death, her
sister bore the weight
of their expectations.
Odin and the Three Wise Men

@c(50,35,20)
    The insolent king @b@c(138,58,23)Odin@/c@/b@c(50,35,20) is the
    sworn enemy of we @b@c(138,58,23)Three Wise 
    Men@/c@/b@c(50,35,20)...Once Erion's greatest magi,
    we had countless disciples, until
    one man infiltrated our library
    posing as a servant.
    
    It was none other than Odin
    himself, in mortal guise...
    
    He whispered to us that he
    knew a path to the Netherworld.

@c(50,35,20)
    In return, he asked for the secret
    of the Psyphers! We were
    outraged by his brazen arrogance,
    and lost our tempers.
    
    We bound him and cast a charm to
    make him speak, but he reflected
    the magic back upon us...

    As he left, Odin cursed us,
    changing us into foul and ugly
    frogs. Such insult can never be
    forgiven!

@c(50,35,20)
    By the time we regained our true
    forms, word of our blunder had
    spread. Our reputation was
    tarnished.
    
    When we lost all else, it was
    @b@c(138,58,23)Gallon@/c@/b@c(50,35,20), the great king of Titania,
    that saved us from poverty.

    We have inherited his legacy
    and his prophecy... and it is
    for him that we shall end
    King Odin.

An account by @b@c(138,58,23)Skuldi@/c@/b, one of
the Three Wise Men. They have
a past with Odin, and their
hatred of him fuels their
many schemes for his defeat.

The Start of the Cauldron War


The source of the conflict
between our grand kingdom
of Ragnanival and Ringford
lies in the past.

Our victory over the mighty
nation of @b@c(158,78,43)Valentine@/c@/b was
assured, but costly. Low on
men and supplies, we had
no choice but to withdraw.



Those vile @b@c(158,78,43)Fairies@/c@/b seized
their chance to invade
Valentine and steal our
prize: the @b@c(158,78,43)Cauldron@/c@/b.

The Cauldron is an artifact
that can create infinite
Phozons. After all we've
sacrificed, such a relic
is rightfully ours!

Anger at the Fairies'
treacherous deed echoed
throughout the country.

For the sake of our fallen
brethren, we vowed to rise
again and punish the Fairies.

Led by King @b@c(158,78,43)Odin@/c@/b, we have
long awaited our revenge,
sharpening our fangs...



Princesses @b@c(158,78,43)Griselda@/c@/b and
@b@c(158,78,43)Gwendolyn@/c@/b, the daughters of
the late queen, are now
skilled Valkyries.

The time has come for war.
We will wreak our
vengeance on the Fairies,
and reclaim our Cauldron!

This memoir shows the
mindset of an Aesir soldier.
In the battle that occurred
after this note, the Aesir
suffered a crushing defeat
that ended with the death of
the first princess.

Tribute to the Queen of the Dead

@c(50,35,20)


@c(50,35,20)
We, the dead, are cursed by the
almighty power of the queen;
fated to have our rotting flesh
torn away by dark specters.


We cannot resist. We may only scour
the realm in search of blue gems...
crystallized souls... to appease
the queen, and quell her ire.

@c(50,35,20)
But the queen's greatest desire is
something beyond our grasp...
A living being, with healthy body
and soul.


Some sell their soul to her as a
living sacrifice, in search of power...
but they, too, rot away in her hands.
Her thirst for souls may never be
quenched...
Two Princes and the Treasured Sword

When @b@c(158,78,43)Gallon@/c@/b, the previous
king of @b@c(158,78,43)Titania@/c@/b yet lived,
Ragnanival gifted them a
@b@c(158,78,43)treasured sword@/c@/b as proof of
their alliance.

It was set with a magical
blade known as a Psypher,
but in Titania, it is now
known as a cursed blade.
So goes the story...

Of the royal sons, the @b@c(158,78,43)elder@/c@/b
took a liking to the mystic
sword, and the king gave
it to him graciously.
As he brandished the blade,
however, he accidentally
injured his father.
Though a minor, shallow cut,
the king was enraged. The
normally gentle monarch's
furor shocked his vassals.

Though even the @b@c(158,78,43)younger son@/c@/b
pleaded his father's
forgiveness, the king grew
cold and distant from the
elder. Eventually, the elder
son renounced his royal blood,
and fled with his lover.
Since that day, the treasured
sword has been thought
cursed, and was buried in
the darkness of history.

An account of the royal
family's incident with the
cursed sword. The source of
King Gallon's rage was never
truly clarified, and mystery
surrounds the tale.
The Law of Titania

Those who do business on "King's
Mainstreet" shall be fined.


Those who do business without
express permission from the king
shall also be fined.


Those who do not pay the tax shall
be executed by hanging.

Those who complain of high taxes
shall be subject to flogging and
the stocks.


Those who discriminate against magi
shall be subject to the stocks.


Those who cause bloodshed shall be
executed on the spot, or by hanging.

King @b@c(158,78,43)Edmund@/c@/b was initially
welcomed by the people as the
heir to the legacy of the wise
previous ruler. When he began
imposing harsh laws and
taxation policies, however,
public favor turned foul.
Royal Survivors of Valentine

North of @b@c(158,78,43)Titania@/c@/b, in the woods
close to the border of the @b@c(158,78,43)Demon
Lord's kingdom@/c@/b, there is an old
and decrepit castle. However,
you must not draw near it.

It was once a villa for the sickly
wife of the Demon Lord, but the
prince and princess of @b@c(158,78,43)Valentine@/c@/b
have been recently sighted there.
They say the young survivors
were spared by the @b@c(158,78,43)Aesir@/c@/b.

But everyone knows @b@c(158,78,43)Valentinians@/c@/b
are blackguards who used their
fearsome magic to invade our land.

Vicious magi like them only know
to bite the hand that feeds them.

I hear @b@c(158,78,43)Prince Cornelius@/c@/b is seen
there often. He is a gentle young
man; I hope he does not fall prey
to their wiles...

This note contains rumors
circulating in Titania.
Valentine is still considered
dangerous by many, and even
the survivors are not spared
public suspicion.
The Fate of Princess Ariel

When the king learned that
Princess @b@c(158,78,43)Ariel@/c@/b gave birth to
fatherless @b@c(158,78,43)twins@/c@/b, she and
they were locked away at the
@b@c(158,78,43)Valentine@/c@/b villa, along with
me, her maid.

Yet life away from the gilt
and politic of the castle
was peaceful. Despite the
guards, it was the perfect
place to raise a family.

The peace did not last.

Enraged over learning the
identity of the twins' father,
the king sent an envoy to
bring the @b@c(158,78,43)princess@/c@/b back.

Her return could only mean
her execution... Even then,
the princess stood firm.

@s(0.95,0.96)She said she had @b@c(158,78,43)prophesied@/c@/b this
future.

However, she did not despair,
but accepted her fate, and
cherished the time she had
remaining.

She entrusted her children to
me, and after her last words
of comfort, she stepped into
the awaiting carriage.@/s

Part of a memo by the maid
of Princess Ariel of Valentine.
She was said to see the future,
and was well-loved by her
people, but was executed as
a rebel.
Maury, the Wandering Chef

My name is @b@c(158,78,43)Maury@/c@/b. I am a Pooka
chef, traveling the world to hone
and perfect my cooking skills.
I also run a touring restaurant,
serving the finest fare wherever
there are hungry travelers in need.

The problem is... my menu is what
you might call somewhat lacking
in variety.

So, gentle reader of this flyer:
I would humbly ask a favor!

I have heard that there are many
@b@c(158,78,43)recipes@/c@/b scattered across Erion.

If you run across any recipes of
culinary import, please... allow me
to take them!

Not without reward, of course!

If you obtain a recipe and the
@b@c(158,78,43)ingredients@/c@/b listed on it, please 
summon me immediately.

You only need ring one of the
@b@c(158,78,43)magic bells@/c@/b I've set up across the
land, and I shall be there in a
trice with my Pooka magic.

I will do my utmost to make you a
delicious meal with whatever you
may bring!
Pookas, Stand Your Tails High!

We citizens of @b@c(158,78,43)Valentine@/c@/b have
lost both our land and our true
forms... but we cannot live out
our lives hiding belowground.

"Collect all the @b@c(158,78,43)magic coins@/c@/b and
lift the curse."

To fulfill our wish, we have all
banded together, and set out
across the world to work, trade,
barter and bargain...

Some serve ale to the barbarians
of the @b@c(158,78,43)Demon Lord@/c@/b, some compete
with greedy merchants plying their
trade in @b@c(158,78,43)Titania@/c@/b, some sweat and
toil for narrow-minded @b@c(158,78,43)Fairies@/c@/b...
Our beastly looks may win us no
favors, but we don't have the
luxury of complaining. One day, we
shall gather the coins to break
this curse and revive our land
with the royal heirs!
This must be kept a @b@c(158,78,43)Pooka@/c@/b secret.

A manifesto written to boost
the morale of the Pookas.
The people of Valentine are
commonly believed to have
perished with their nation,
but they survived as Pookas,
and are working to revive it.
Pooka Kitchen & Cafe Flyer

To anyone with
Valentinian coins.

We Welcome You!
Gourmand Heaven
Pooka Village

At the "@b@c(158,78,43)Rabbit Cafe@/c@/b" and "@b@c(158,78,43)Pooka
Kitchen@/c@/b", we serve delicious food
and lovely sweets.




We accept any of these coins!

All you need to do is pay the bill!
We provide all our own fresh
@b@c(158,78,43)ingredients@/c@/b. When you come to@b@c(158,78,43) the
Pooka village@/c@/b, please drop by!
Valentine's Rise & Fall

@s(0.92,0.95)The @b@c(158,78,43)Crystallization Cauldron@/c@/b,
engineered from the most potent
of Valentine's magic, was the crux
of the king's glorious nation.

By way of crystallizing raw
@b@c(158,78,43)Phozons@/c@/b, it produced dense magic.
It was the source of the nation's
wealth, and iconic of Valentine
at the height of their power.@/s

@s(0.96,0.96)At the peak of the kingdom's
prosperity, the end came.
@b@c(158,78,43)Ragnanival@/c@/b, the country with
whom Valentine was at war,
launched a desperate attack on
the capital. A bright light
suddenly engulfed the city, and
a terrible storm swept across
the land.

Only rubble remained.@/s

@s(0.92,0.95)To this day, none know the true
cause of Valentine's fall. The
truth may lie somewhere within
the last remaining artifact of
their genius—the roiling
Cauldron.

Historians from far and wide have
long sought the answers behind
this mystery.@/s
The Fairy Queen's Triumph

@s(0.94,0.95)The @b@c(158,78,43)Forest of Fairies@/c@/b was once a
peaceful place where many races
lived in tranquility. Queen
@b@c(158,78,43)Elfaria@/c@/b's greatest achievement
was to unite everyone as a
nation. Her legend will be passed
down for eons to come.

But that great deed did not
come easily.@/s

@s(0.94,0.95)The queen's greatest obstacle
was the tension between the
@b@c(158,78,43)Fairies@/c@/b and the @b@c(158,78,43)Dwarves@/c@/b.

Believing the Dwarves' smithing
skills invaluable, the queen tried
compromise, but the Fairies
bristled at their diplomacy,
slowing talks. And when they
acquired the magic @b@c(158,78,43)Cauldron@/c@/b,
opinions clashed further...@/s

@s(0.93,0.95)The Dwarves wanted to use the
Cauldron's supreme power to its
fullest, making it a foundation of
the nation's might... And the
Fairies opposed overusing the
dangerous Cauldron, remembering
its role in the destruction of
@b@c(158,78,43)Valentine@/c@/b.

Tensions soon flared into war.@/s

@s(0.94,0.95)In the heat of battle, the losing
Dwarves tried to control the
Cauldron, and caused a magical
flood that swept through the
forest. The @b@c(158,78,43)queen@/c@/b ordered all
soldiers to rescue everyone,
friend or foe, and stood against
the Cauldron herself, stifling its
onslaught and preventing
further damage to the land.@/s

@s(0.94,0.95)The war was over. The Dwarves
awaited their punishment. But
